highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155 previews Skia m155, HarfBuzz 14.4, and Ganesh cache and Linux font-matching corrections.

breaking.title: Use an external RAW decoder
breaking.body: Built-in RAW/DNG decoding and PIEX extraction of embedded JPEG previews are disabled; no replacement reader is included. Decode RAW files with an external reader and pass decoded pixels or a supported encoded format to SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng retains value 10 for compatibility but does not indicate codec availability. Standalone JPEG decoding remains available.

bullets.detail: Updates the engine to milestone 155 while preserving rotation-scale text-run bounds and the existing managed binding surface.

Updates the native shaping engine with intentional cross-direction mark-positioning changes, glyph-position saturation, malformed-font crash and hang fixes, and shaping and subsetting performance work.
Adds documented OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enum values. The native raw-value fetch functions remain internal; no Face wrappers are introduced.
Drops uniquely held thread-safe cache entries after a failed Ganesh flush so subsequent draws cannot reuse textures that were never initialized. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed.
Tests family acceptability only on the first valid sorted candidate so a lower-ranked metric-compatible substitute does not prevent trying the next requested family.

preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14: Opened the Skia m155 line without changing the managed API surface.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13: Updated native HarfBuzz to 14.4.0 and added OpenType tag enums. Removed built-in RAW/DNG decoding and embedded RAW-preview extraction.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8: Corrected Ganesh cache cleanup after failed flushes and first-candidate matching in Linux fontconfig.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates bundled HarfBuzz to 14.4.0, including cross-direction mark-positioning changes, glyph-position saturation, malformed-font fixes, and shaping and subsetting improvements. Adds OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enums while keeping raw fetch functions internal.

v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14.headline: Preview 1 opened the Skia m155 line without changing the managed API surface.

v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13.headline: Preview 2 updated HarfBuzz to 14.4.0 and removed built-in RAW/DNG decoding and embedded RAW-preview extraction.

v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8.headline: The release candidate corrected Ganesh cache cleanup after failed flushes and Linux fontconfig first-candidate matching.
